findings.current: It erased the afterimages created by the Taeeul Light-Dividing Sword, which had split into dozens of wavering images, before finally merging into a single blade.
findings.defect: The dangling construction makes the hellfire merge into a blade. In the source, the sword has already recombined into one blade, and the hellfire reaches it after erasing its afterimages.
findings.rationale: The subject of 하나로 합쳐진 is the sword blade, while the hellfire’s action is 닿았다, reaching that blade.
findings.replacement: It erased the wavering afterimages created by the Taeeul Light-Dividing Sword when it split into dozens, then reached the blade as it finally recombined into one.
findings.source: 수십 개로 분열되어 어른거리던 태을분광검이 만들어 낸 잔상을 지우고, 마침내 하나로 합쳐진 검신에 닿았다.

findings.current: Blue flames wrapped in wind tore through the tea house’s ceiling and shot upward like a waterspout.
findings.defect: The wrapping relationship is reversed: the flames wrap around the wind, not the wind around the flames.
findings.rationale: 바람을 휘감은 modifies 푸른 화염 and identifies the wind as what the flames encircle.
findings.replacement: Blue flames coiled around the wind, tore through the tea house’s ceiling, and surged upward like a waterspout.
findings.source: 바람을 휘감은 푸른 화염이 다루의 천장을 뚫고 용오름 치듯 솟구쳤다.

findings.current:
The old man’s eyelids trembled.

Hwangbo Eom’s eyes widened.
findings.defect: The draft adds an unsupported second reaction, widening his eyes, and separates Hwangbo Eom’s identification from the source action.
findings.rationale: The source contains only trembling eyelids and identifies the old man as Hwangbo Eom within that sentence.
findings.replacement: At the sight, the eyelids of the old man, Hwangbo Eom, trembled.
findings.source: 그 광경에 노인, 황보엄의 눈꺼풀이 파르르 떨렸다.

findings.current: Hwangbo Eom possessed a jiazi of internal energy and had reached the Supreme Peak realm.
findings.defect: The quantity is halved: 이 갑자 means two jiazi, not one.
findings.rationale: 이 is the Sino-Korean numeral two here, making the stated accumulation 120 years rather than one sixty-year cycle.
findings.replacement: Hwangbo Eom possessed two jiazi of internal energy and had reached the Supreme Peak realm.
findings.source: 이 갑자의 공력과 초절정의 경지에 이른 그다.

findings.current: Blood trickled from Hwangbo Eom’s mouth as he let out a dry cough.
findings.defect: The draft changes coughing up a substantial mouthful of blood into blood merely trickling from his mouth.
findings.rationale: 토해 냈다 is active expulsion, and 한 줌 conveys a distinct quantity rather than a trickle.
findings.replacement: A dry cough escaped Hwangbo Eom, followed by a mouthful of blood.
findings.source: 황보엄은 메마른 기침과 함께 한 줌의 핏물을 토해 냈다.

findings.current:
A jiazi of internal energy poured into the Sword Force?

A martial art of the Supreme Peak realm?
findings.defect: The draft again reduces two jiazi of internal energy to one.
findings.rationale: 이 갑자 explicitly denotes two sixty-year cycles.
findings.replacement:
Two jiazi of internal energy poured into the Sword Force?

A martial art of the Supreme Peak realm?
findings.source: 이 갑자의 공력을 쏟아부은 검강? 초절정의 무공?

findings.current: He had not even seen the young man draw his weapon.
findings.defect: The draft changes an unseen attack or move into drawing a weapon, even though Taekyung’s spear was already in use.
findings.rationale: 출수 means launching or making an attack, not unsheathing or drawing a weapon.
findings.replacement: He had not even seen the young man make his move.

findings.defect: The second “No” loses Taekyung’s interruption and completion of Hwangbo Eom’s unfinished 안 돼, reversing the deadpan response.
findings.rationale: Hwangbo Eom begins 안 돼, meaning that Taekyung cannot do it, and Taekyung cuts in with 돼, asserting that he can.

findings.current: The stage of the war between the orthodox and demonic factions had fallen half a century ago, and the heroes had scattered in every direction.
findings.defect: The draft both misstates the theatrical image—the curtain falls, not the stage—and narrows 사 to a demonic faction rather than the broader unorthodox faction.
findings.rationale: 막을 내렸다 refers to the curtain falling, while 정사 contrasts the orthodox and unorthodox sides of the Murim.
findings.replacement: The curtain had fallen on the war between the orthodox and unorthodox factions half a century ago, and the heroes had scattered in every direction.
findings.source: 정사대전이라는 무대는 반세기 전에 막을 내렸고, 영웅들은 뿔뿔이 흩어졌다.

findings.current: “The Taeeul Formless Sword. Watch closely. This is the sword art that will cut off your breath.”
findings.defect: “Cut off your breath” is an unnatural literal rendering of a threat to kill someone.
findings.rationale: 숨통을 끊다 is an idiomatic threat meaning to kill, and “take your life” preserves its force naturally.
findings.replacement: “The Taeeul Formless Sword. Watch closely. This is the sword art that will take your life.”
findings.source: “태을무형검(太乙無形劍). 똑똑히 보아라. 네놈의 숨통을 끊을 검공이니.”

findings.current: It was martial arts—a supreme sword art wielded by a martial artist who had attained greater enlightenment than I had and was forcing his internal energy into a rampage.
findings.defect: The established rendering of 초절 as “supreme mastery” is lost, weakening the explicit description of the sword art’s attained level.
findings.rationale: 초절 is the glossary-bound concept “supreme mastery,” not merely a generic adjective meaning impressive or supreme.
findings.replacement: It was martial arts—a sword art of supreme mastery wielded by a martial artist who had attained greater enlightenment than I had and was forcing his internal energy into a rampage.
findings.source: 무공, 나보다 더 높은 깨달음을 이룩한 무인이 공력을 폭주시키면서까지 펼쳐 내는 초절(超絶)의 검공이었다.

findings.current: The Fire Dragon Claw seized the Sword Force.
findings.defect: Capitalization turns the descriptive fire dragon’s claw into the separately named Fire Dragon Claw technique used earlier, conflating two distinct expressions.
findings.rationale: The named technique is 화룡조, whereas this sentence uses the possessive phrase 화룡의 발톱 as imagery within Heavenly Strike.
findings.replacement: The fire dragon’s claw seized the Sword Force.

summary: The draft contains several altered physical actions, two major quantity errors, an added reaction, and localized losses in humor, terminology, and faction identity.
